info.name: ArgueBot local conversation service
info.description: Runnable local contract coverage. The open workspace has no user accounts. Provider credentials are write-only configuration. State-creating requests use fictional records. Model execution, settings changes and restart require allowExecution=true; use the committed local simulation before enabling it. Generated from assets/api-contract.json and the typed C# DTOs.

item.name: Return zero-filled UTC activity buckets for a bounded range

request.description: Open workspace endpoint.  Return zero-filled UTC activity buckets for a bounded range

exec: if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Activity has fixed intervals and nonnegative counts',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json();const minutes=Number(pm.variables.get('bucketMinutes'));const from=Date.parse(pm.variables.get('fromUtc')),to=Date.parse(pm.variables.get('toUtc'));pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array');if(rows.length){pm.expect(rows.length).to.equal(Math.ceil((to-from)/(minutes*60000)));rows.forEach((row,index)=>{pm.expect(Date.parse(row.startUtc)).to.equal(from+index*minutes*60000);pm.expect(row.success).to.be.at.least(0);pm.expect(row.failure).to.be.at.least(0);});}});

item.name: Discover panel limits and unanimity policy

request.description: Open workspace endpoint.  Discover panel limits and unanimity policy

exec: pm.test('Explicit unanimous panel protocol is available',()=>{const value=pm.response.json();pm.expect(value.debateProtocol).to.equal(2);pm.expect(value.maxParticipants).to.be.at.least(2);pm.expect(value.consensusPolicy).to.equal('unanimous');pm.expect(value.deliveryModes).to.include.members(['interrupt_now','next_turn']);});
